column5: A1: the frozen order sentence says _owntree_ok runs before the basename test; the bytes run the last-component test first (c1-pointer-counter.py:349) then _owntree_ok (:353), outcome-equivalent on all 32 rows and 5 regressions (refused_true=0). Reviewer independently re-derived 32/0/0/0 and both control/Q149 receipts; 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 3 LOW.

A5 (and A1): M07/NR6 show a suffix-only own-tree rule passes all three committed conjuncts, so the population cannot separate the identity clause from a suffix rule; M08 shows the identity disjunct is unreachable by verdict; independently re-found the order mismatch. 6 of 8 mutants killed incl. M01 (drop _owntree_ok -> 2 accepted).

A2: F1 MEDIUM - the own-tree rule refuses a genuine own-tree move into the lane's real wN/ wave dirs (65 w1, 19 w2, 0 named waves/) while keeping the harness-planted waves/a2w1/ shape; r81 accepted both. L1 re-derived the truth table directly. F4: K-a before=4 is the modal value of 1,2,4,4,4 runs.

A3: the r82 census-in-tree branch (:365-371) never fires on the frozen rows (no token under census/), so the prereg's PF-1/NF-H attribution to it is false and a cheaper rule reaches 32/0/0; the census half is quality hardening inside a calibration claim. Core delta (NF-F/NF-G 2 -> 0) HOLDS.

A3 for F2 (PF-1 branch dead code, independently of CriticClaims). F1 adopted only as provenance (K-b is the r81 counter, 2 docstring lines apart) and its stronger conclusion REJECTED: removing _owntree_ok yields exactly that counter, so K-b does isolate the round's only load-bearing new code (A4). 8 sibling rows documented read-only; cross-claim separation verified separable both ways.

A6: F-1 MEDIUM - W2 replaced base's ${CLI_PID:-${!:-}} with ${CLI_PID:-} (:245), so a signal between `timeout ... &` (:290) and CLI_PID=$! (:291) prints "stopped it, no verdict" and orphans the subtree; base 0/150 vs W2 1/150 A/B, window 4.07 ms on the real tool; the prereg's "$! is never the timeout pid here" is false (:290 is the only background launch) and the prereg's stated limits do not cover this window. Repaired before filing by W3 R1; frozen 16/0/0/0 re-derived by this seat on the committed bytes.

A7: counter:217 tests rid.startswith("m-"), which never matches m1-monitor-term-fork / m2-monitor-hup-fork, so the m1/m2 rows carry no monitor of their own under the default launch (they duplicate v7/v8); the monitor evidence is the whole-counter launch. Also MEDIUM: M03 (TERM-only tree) and M06 (trap reset) survive the frozen rows; termign-fork and p5-late-term are missing rows (p5 reproduced: pristine rc=-15 vs M06 rc=143 with SIG line).

Adjudicates the S330 pgrep(1) reject (agrees, flip condition sufficient) and the 6 routed defects; no claim number re-run. Its Defect-4 line repeats the falsified rule-order sentence, so this seat's agreement is not independent corroboration of A1; its note that the carried-list "wave coverage" phrase could mislead is adopted in the report's V1 disposition.
